notes: viewpoints: graph nodes where a search scans 360 degrees, in order, stopping early on FOUND. The pad, then spots that see around furniture; the *_far spot looks along the strip behind the bench/desk/table. Chosen with a 2-D line-of-sight coverage check of each room's floor.

Coverage was checked with a 2-D line-of-sight test over each room's floor (camera 3 cm high, so any furniture or object blocks the view): hidden floor was 8-23% with two viewpoints and 0-3% with three. The setup Supervisor's spawn_points.json is never read by the robot controller.
rooms: [xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax] from the partition walls at x = +/-2 and y = 0, used to say which room an estimated ball position falls in.
